name: frontendskills
description: Senior engineering judgment as audit-first Claude Code skills, one plugin per domain: core (stack-profile wizard, security, workflow), frontend, backend, infra, CLI, AI and game development. Enable only what your stack uses.

plugins.name: devcore
plugins.description: The core every other plugin builds on: a one-time stack-profile wizard, on-demand skill authoring, toolchain and security audits, commit and PR writing, and the shared security, logging and observability contracts.

plugins.name: frontendskills
plugins.description: Vite-SPA app lifecycle for React 19 / Vue 3 (state, routing, forms, auth, testing, performance, a11y) plus a framework-agnostic landing-page catalogue (SEO, lead capture, content and copy audits).

plugins.name: backendskills
plugins.description: Backend services on TypeScript (Hono + Drizzle), Go, Python (FastAPI), Supabase and Next.js 16: API contracts, Postgres and migrations, auth, jobs, hardening, OpenTelemetry and tests.

plugins.name: infraskills
plugins.description: Ship and run it: containers, OpenTofu, Vercel, Hetzner and IONOS deploys, a build-once-promote pipeline, secrets, and an OpenTelemetry collector.

plugins.name: cliskills
plugins.description: Build and release command-line tools that behave (exit codes, --json, config precedence) and set up a repo's dev toolchain (mise, task runner, git hooks).

plugins.name: aiskills
plugins.description: LLM features done properly: one provider seam, RAG pipelines with hybrid retrieval, evals in CI, MCP servers, and LLM-specific security.

plugins.name: gameskills
plugins.description: Rust + Bevy game development: fast-compile scaffold, plugin-per-feature ECS architecture, asset loading, headless system tests, and performance.
